text: This is the Unstable SMP, the world's largest Minecraft server.
Home to some of the biggest builds and civilizations in all of Minecraft,
and with tens of thousands of players online at any given moment,
there is always an adventure here to be had.
But, with every player only having one life,
there's also danger lurking around every corner.

there's not enough resources to go around,
